name: NemoClaw
title_zh: 把主流 Agent 安全关进 NVIDIA 托管推理
tagline_zh: 跑 Hermes、LangChain Deep Agents、OpenClaw 时不再裸奔——OpenShell 。
tagline_en: Run Hermes, LangChain Deep Agents, OpenClaw inside OpenShell's managed inference—no more bare-metal agent sprawl.
desc_en: Run agents like Hermes, LangChain Deep Agents, and OpenClaw more securely inside NVIDIA OpenShell with managed inference
why_zh: 不是包装纸，是隔离层：推理走 NVIDIA 托管通道，Agent 的任意工具调用都过 OpenShel。
why_en: Not a wrapper—an isolation layer: inference flows through NVIDIA's managed channel, every tool call passes OpenShell's policy.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 OpenShell 生态内的 Agent；自带模型得是 NVIDIA 托管的，自建 vLLM 或本地权重不生效。
limit_en: Only works inside OpenShell with NVIDIA-managed inference; self-hosted vLLM or local weights ignored. Agents outside Hermes/LangChain/OpenClaw need.
